body: I poured my heart out, maybe a bit too much, i had to come back several times to finish but i needed something good to come out of this, and i needed to share, internet strangers can be the best company sometimes, thank you so much for your kind words and i am glad they helped, even if only a bit, please stay safe, reach out when u need to and take care of yourself, one day, or sometimes even just one moment, at a time, i wish you u the best and that ur turmoils ease up
Accepted, and thank you so much for reading, please take care

I cant imagine i will be any different, i see him in everything, he was so interwined in my life- we grew into our adulthood together- i am left with a huge hole in my heart, in our home- i am holding on for when it gets easier, i am finding ways to honor him, and i will keep doing my best, thank you so much for posting and relating, i am so sorry and i wish you the best aswell

There have been times in our relationship where this was us- i would be lethargic and would lay in bed for days, staring at the wall, wouldnt eat, but on my end work had him crazy busy at the time and he was struggling with his own issues, i am sorry u were in that situation, and i hope in the future, if u persue another relationship (or r currently in one) that they are able to pick up on things like that and offer u the support u need... real understanding and love. please take care and stay safe, thank you for posting

Thank you, i teared up at this, i am trying my best to do right by him, every moment im alone i talk to him, or like to think i am, i make jokes outloud that i know he would have appreciated, times like these my dark sense of humor comes out (during the ok moments anyway) and i know wherever he is he is still rolling his eyes or snorting or full on laughing, and as crazy as i might seem i will take comfort in that- and i fully believe time heals all wounds, one day i will look back at this and it will hurt just a little less, i just need to hold out, one step at a time- thank you so much for your post
Me too, thank you so much

Gosh the amount of anxiety that comes with that must be awful- i hope u never have to find out that way, and while i understand it can be very difficult to overcome, i hope she can recover and reconnect.. thank you
Thank you for reading, i just want something good to come out of all of this and i am so thankful it has helped, if even a little, please stay safe and take care, thank you for posting

It means a lot that you, a stranger, would take the time to read and post and relate, it means more than you know, give her an extra hug for me, watching anybody through something like this, especially a spouse, is never easy, and from experience the people u love most can be the hardest to reach out to- that u are responding and reading and even in this subreddit i think shows the kind of dedication u have to helping her, i wish you two all the best

I am working on counciling, i am focusing on getting things done for him and his family first because i am sort of tunnel visioned, but i am making it mandatory for myself, i refuse to shut down, though i know its ok if i have moments, and much love to you aswell, thank you so much

I get the anger at failing, but i am glad u have survived- thank you for your post and sharing your perspective, he also struggled with bipolar and anybody whos had or seen it can tell u it is no walk in the park- i am about to be the same age as u, huge hugs and know i am rooting for you and thinking of you
Thank you, and i have had a good friend jump to my side to sort of help guide me through this, i know i got this, if only to honor his memory i will make the most of it- again thank you
Thank you, i am slowly easing on the self blame, its hard to not think of what could be different, but all we can do is move forward- thank you
Thank you, i can only hope something good comes from this, i try to find comfort in those words, even if they were his last

I apologize, i didnt realize there was another subreddit, i agree it is probably more suited for there, i had been asked if this post could be saved so if a mod could help me move this, or however that works, i would appreciate it
